tools.name: manyrequests_list_clients
tools.description: List the portal's clients (customers): name, email and creation date. Use it first to find a client id. API: GET /clients.

tools.name: manyrequests_get_client
tools.description: Get one client by id, optionally with its organization. API: GET /clients/{client}.

tools.name: manyrequests_list_organizations
tools.description: List organizations (companies that clients belong to), with optional search and subscription status filters. API: GET /organizations.

tools.name: manyrequests_get_organization
tools.description: Get one organization by id. API: GET /organizations/{organization}.

tools.name: manyrequests_list_organization_subscriptions
tools.description: List the recurring services (subscriptions) of one organization, with their status. API: GET /organizations/{organization}/services.

tools.name: manyrequests_list_requests
tools.description: List service requests (the work items of the portal), filterable by text, status, priority, client, organization, service, tags and due date. API: GET /requests.

tools.name: manyrequests_get_request
tools.description: Get one request by id or slug, optionally with its status, client, service, assignees, tags and counts. API: GET /requests/{request}.

tools.name: manyrequests_list_request_comments
tools.description: List the comments on one request, optionally only internal or only client-visible ones. API: GET /requests/{requestKey}/comments.

tools.name: manyrequests_list_request_time_entries
tools.description: List the logged time entries of one request, filterable by user and description. API: GET /requests/{requestKey}/time-entries.

tools.name: manyrequests_list_request_activity
tools.description: List the activity log of one request (status changes, comments, time entries and other events). API: GET /requests/{requestKey}/activity.

tools.name: manyrequests_list_services
tools.description: List the services the portal sells or runs requests for (one-off and recurring), with optional search. API: GET /services.

tools.name: manyrequests_get_service
tools.description: Get one service by id. API: GET /services/{service}.

tools.name: manyrequests_list_service_form_fields
tools.description: List the intake form fields of one service: the questions a client answers when they create a request. API: GET /services/{service}/form-fields.

tools.name: manyrequests_list_request_statuses
tools.description: List the request statuses of the portal (for example To do, In progress, Done). Use the ids with manyrequests_list_requests. API: GET /request-statuses.

tools.name: manyrequests_list_team_members
tools.description: List the team members of the portal (staff who work on requests), with their roles. Use the ids as assignees or comment authors. API: GET /team-members.

tools.name: manyrequests_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices, filterable by client, organization, status, number and payment gateway. API: GET /invoices.

tools.name: manyrequests_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id, with its status, number, notes and payment reference. API: GET /invoices/{invoice}.

tools.name: manyrequests_create_request
tools.description: CREATE a new service request for a client. Required: service_id, client_id, title. Visible to the client's portal once created; not undoable from this tool (there is no delete). API: POST /requests.

tools.name: manyrequests_create_request_comment
tools.description: ADD a comment to one request. Set is_internal true to keep it staff-only; false (default) makes it visible to the client. Required: body, user_id (the team member who writes it). API: POST /requests/{requestKey}/comments.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: manyrequests_list_clients, manyrequests_list_request_comments, manyrequests_list_request_activity, manyrequests_list_team_members · Public sink: manyrequests_list_clients, manyrequests_create_request, manyrequests_create_request_comment · Destructive: manyrequests_create_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: manyrequests_list_clients, manyrequests_list_request_comments, manyrequests_list_request_activity, manyrequests_list_team_members · Public sink: manyrequests_list_clients, manyrequests_create_request, manyrequests_create_request_comment · Destructive: manyrequests_create_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
